verdict.rationale: An agent can submit several compliance filings through the API: tax registration generates an ELSTER XML that is sent to the tax office, with a status-polling endpoint (docs-7, docs-25, docs-31). There is also a trade-registration endpoint (docs-8), Beglaubigt handles post-incorporation filings such as the Transparenzregister entry (docs-24), and an llms.txt supports agent consumption (probe-1). However, these are one-off registration filings rather than recurring annual reports, and the Compliance API is Enterprise-only with undocumented scope (docs-33). Missing for 10: any annual-report or recurring compliance-filing capability, documentation of what the Compliance API actually files, a published OpenAPI spec (probe-2), and independent or hands-on evidence of agent-driven filing with minimal human input.
